name: Lakmé Perfect Radiance Intense Whitening Foundation | Oil-Free Natural Finish
description:
Achieve a naturally radiant look with Lakmé Perfect Radiance Intense Whitening Foundation — your go-to formula for flawless, even-toned skin all day long. This oil-free, lightweight foundation provides smooth coverage that blends effortlessly, giving your skin a natural, luminous finish without clogging pores. Enriched with brightening ingredients, it helps improve skin tone while offering long-lasting wear that resists smudging and streaking. Whether you’re heading to work or a special event, this foundation keeps your complexion looking fresh, bright, and confident from morning till night.Key Features:
 Intense whitening and brightening effect
 Oil-free formula with natural finish
 Long-lasting, smudge-proof coverage
 Keeps skin soft, smooth, and supple
 Suitable for all skin types

How to Use:
① Apply dots of foundation on cleansed, moisturized skin.
② Blend evenly with fingers, sponge, or brush.
③ Set with compact powder for a flawless matte look.
